answers.core: Having mesh files, I can change them in the code for the meshinstance node, for example. I can read them like a regular array and store them in a non-video memory. This allows me a lot. Just data in a simple format.
answers.workaround: Yes, it is possible to convert models to obj, which are close to *mesh and also don't create scenes when imported. But the native engine format is better, I believe.

title: Bring back the ability to import models as a *.mesh file!
